strixhaven.rule.underground-cave-scry-pr.combines: Blocks attempts to magically observe its occupants, objects, and location.
strixhaven.rule.underground-cave-scry-pr.blocked_reason: The rule directly prevents magical information-gathering about the protected area.

strixhaven.rule.clinging-to-life.name: Clinging to Life

effect.summary: Death saving throws in the affected region are made with advantage.

strixhaven.rule.clinging-to-life.cost_or_limit: Ends 1d6 days after the ritual ends or is interrupted.
strixhaven.rule.clinging-to-life.combines: One of the ritual's regional effects.
strixhaven.rule.clinging-to-life.blocked_reason: It modifies checks for creatures throughout a region.

strixhaven.rule.grievous-wounds.name: Grievous Wounds

effect.summary: A creature that scores a critical hit rolls one extra damage die.

strixhaven.rule.grievous-wounds.cost_or_limit: Ends 1d6 days after the ritual ends or is interrupted.
strixhaven.rule.grievous-wounds.who_may: Creatures scoring critical hits in the region.
strixhaven.rule.grievous-wounds.combines: One of the ritual's regional effects.
strixhaven.rule.grievous-wounds.blocked_reason: The effect alters attacks across a region.

strixhaven.rule.withered-vegetation.name: Withered Vegetation

effect.summary: Vegetation within a mile of the fortress becomes withered and sickly.

strixhaven.rule.withered-vegetation.cost_or_limit: Ends 1d6 days after the ritual ends or is interrupted.
strixhaven.rule.withered-vegetation.combines: One of the ritual's regional effects.
strixhaven.rule.withered-vegetation.blocked_reason: It changes vegetation throughout a region.

strixhaven.rule.desecrated-earth.name: Desecrated Earth

effect.summary: Undead gain advantage on saves against being turned in the necrotic area.

strixhaven.rule.desecrated-earth.cost_or_limit: Applies to undead in the area.
strixhaven.rule.desecrated-earth.blocked_reason: It modifies a category of creatures throughout a location.

strixhaven.rule.necrotic-locus-damage-me.name: Necrotic Locus damage methods

effect.summary: A successful physical or magical method damages the Locus, while failure harms the user.

strixhaven.rule.necrotic-locus-damage-me.cost_or_limit: Physical attempts use DC 15 Athletics; magic requires an action and a DC 15 Arcana check.
strixhaven.rule.necrotic-locus-damage-me.go_wrong: A failed attempt deals necrotic damage to the character.
strixhaven.rule.necrotic-locus-damage-me.who_may: A character within reach can attempt either method.
strixhaven.rule.necrotic-locus-damage-me.where_from: The Locus's unstable construction and magical core.
strixhaven.rule.necrotic-locus-damage-me.combines: Success can ignore some of the Locus's defenses.
strixhaven.rule.necrotic-locus-damage-me.blocked_reason: The rule uses ordinary checks, damage, and object durability.

strixhaven.rule.friends-refresh-the-part.name: Friends refresh the party

effect.summary: The narrative power of friendship may provide the benefits of a short rest without an hour's wait.

strixhaven.rule.friends-refresh-the-part.cost_or_limit: Offered as a way to grant short-rest benefits during the story.
strixhaven.rule.friends-refresh-the-part.where_from: A suggested approach after the Necrotic Locus is destroyed.
strixhaven.rule.friends-refresh-the-part.blocked_reason: The passage specifies a recovery benefit that can be represented directly.

strixhaven.rule.ritual-stones-required.name: Ritual stones required

effect.summary: Murgaxor cannot complete the ritual or manipulate life and death without five ritual stones.

strixhaven.rule.ritual-stones-required.cost_or_limit: All five stones are required for the ritual.
strixhaven.rule.ritual-stones-required.go_wrong: Without them, the ritualist would be overwhelmed by the forces involved.
strixhaven.rule.ritual-stones-required.who_may: Murgaxor's ritual depends on the stones.
strixhaven.rule.ritual-stones-required.where_from: The ritual's dependence on its stones.
strixhaven.rule.ritual-stones-required.combines: Destroying all five stones ends the ritual.
strixhaven.rule.ritual-stones-required.blocked_reason: A required-component rule and its interruption condition are straightforward to implement.

strixhaven.rule.stopping-the-ritual.name: Stopping the Ritual

effect.summary: Destroying Murgaxor's barrier and all ritual stones ends his ritual and lair actions.

strixhaven.rule.stopping-the-ritual.cost_or_limit: Requires destroying the barrier and five stones; reducing Murgaxor to 0 hit points also interrupts the ritual.
strixhaven.rule.stopping-the-ritual.go_wrong: Creatures and effects summoned by lair actions become harmless material.
strixhaven.rule.stopping-the-ritual.combines: Removes Murgaxor's lair actions and dissipates his ritual powers.
strixhaven.rule.stopping-the-ritual.blocked_reason: Stopping the ritual changes the availability of powers and transforms their summoned effects.
